description: Locale configuration for Tamil language in Moment.js, including date formats, relative time, calendar settings, and number parsing/formatting.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Returns the ordinal string for a given number, appending 'வது'.

methods.name: preparse
methods.description: Converts Tamil numerals in a string to Western numerals.

methods.name: postformat
methods.description: Converts Western numerals in a string to Tamil numerals.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Determines the Tamil meridiem indicator based on the hour.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Converts hour and meridiem indicator to 24-hour format.
